disclaimer.text: Stamina gives general fitness and nutrition guidance for healthy adults. It is not a medical device and doesn't diagnose, treat or replace advice from a doctor, physiotherapist or dietitian. Stop and seek medical help if you feel unwell.

healthData.title: Your health data
healthData.intro: To keep your training safe, Stamina asks about your health. This is separate from the notice above, and it is your choice.
healthData.collects: What we collect: your Screening answers now, and later your check-ins, training and body data.
healthData.where: Where it is kept: in the EU, encrypted.
healthData.sharing: It is never sent to AI providers or to analytics.
healthData.withdraw: You can withdraw this consent at any time. Then you can export or delete your data.
healthData.accept: I agree that Stamina may process my health data as described above.

screening.title: A few health questions
screening.intro: These help keep your training safe. Answer for how things are for you today.

questions.heart-condition: Has a doctor ever told you that you have a heart condition, have had a stroke, or have high blood pressure?
questions.chest-pain: In the last 12 months, have you had chest pain, pressure or discomfort, at rest or during activity?
questions.fainting: In the last 12 months, have you fainted, lost consciousness, or lost your balance because of dizziness?
questions.diabetes-or-kidney: Do you have diabetes (type 1 or 2) or kidney disease?
questions.breathing: Do you get short of breath at rest or with light effort, or did you need medical care for asthma in the last 12 months?
questions.bone-joint-muscle: Do you have a bone, joint or muscle problem that activity could make worse?
questions.head-injury: Have you had a concussion or head injury in the last 12 months?
questions.supervised-exercise: Has a doctor told you to exercise only under medical supervision?
questions.eating-disorder: Are you being treated for an eating disorder?
